action.hypothesis: Starting from the diffusion baseline and focusing on the hottest sector 6 with adjoint-informed swaps should yield legal fixed-inventory candidates that reduce far-field leakage and tail risk.
action.expected_observation: A batch of compiler-generated diffusion-prefiltered structures with varied one-for-one material swaps, including candidates with lower far_cvar90, far_max, or worst_sector_mean than the baseline.
action.decision_reason: Only generate_structures is executable now; the campaign requires candidate structures before GMC screening, guided regeneration, and eventual MC certification. Using the baseline as parent and sector 6 as focus targets the dominant observed leakage channel while maintaining exploration.

action.hypothesis: GMC screening of the diffusion-prefiltered batch will rank candidates by cached high-throughput leakage response and expose flux fields needed for GMC-guided regeneration.
action.expected_observation: GMC risk, far-field, tail, and hot-sector metrics for the submitted signatures, with at least two screened candidates and reusable GMC flux-field guidance for the next generation round.
action.decision_reason: The required discovery cycle is generate -> GMC screen -> regenerate from GMC field -> GMC rescreen, and Monte Carlo is locked until the GMC screening and GMC-guided cycle requirements are met. Screening the awaiting candidates is the necessary next step.

action.hypothesis: The two lowest-diffusion-risk adjoint candidates (absorber moved to cell [4,3], removing low-sensitivity cells [5,1] and [5,5]) should also rank best under the cached GMC flux operator, and their GMC fields will guide the next generation round.
action.expected_observation: GMC risk, far-field mean, CVaR90, max, and hot-sector metrics for both signatures, plus reusable cached flux fields; at least two GMC-screened candidates satisfying the minimum screening batch.
action.decision_reason: The previous screen_gmc call was rejected because this call permits only 2 new GenVR/GMC evaluations, so I screen the two best diffusion-prefiltered candidates. This starts the required generate -> GMC screen -> regenerate-from-GMC-field -> rescreen cycle and keeps Monte Carlo locked until the GMC-guided gate is met.

action.hypothesis: Regenerating from the two GMC-screened parents using their cached flux fields and focusing on the hottest sector 4 will produce at least one GMC-guided candidate that further reduces GMC risk, satisfying the GMC-guided discovery gate.
action.expected_observation: New compiler-generated structures with diffusion-prefiltered risks, including at least one GMC-guided candidate ready for GMC rescreening.
action.decision_reason: The required cycle is generate -> GMC screen -> regenerate from GMC field -> GMC rescreen. Two candidates are GMC-screened; next we regenerate from those parents to create GMC-guided structures, then rescreen them. This is necessary to unlock Monte Carlo certification.

action.hypothesis: The two GMC-guided children of the screened parents, especially d7d960548ee7 (lowest diffusion risk, 0.0736), should improve on their parents' GMC risk (~0.09-0.11) and satisfy the GMC-guided screening gate.
action.expected_observation: GMC risk, far-field mean, CVaR90, max, and worst-sector metrics for both guided candidates, with at least one guided-and-screened structure recorded and cached flux fields for further breeding.
action.decision_reason: Discovery cycle requires generate -> GMC screen -> regenerate -> GMC rescreen. Two parents already screened and guided children generated, so rescreening the best guided children is the mandatory next step to unlock MC certification; budget permits only 2 GenVR evaluations.

action.hypothesis: The GMC-screened candidate d7d960548ee7, which has the lowest GMC risk and best far-field tail metrics among screened designs, will show a statistically significant reduction in far-field neutron flux and tail hotspots compared with the baseline under unbiased Monte Carlo certification.
action.expected_observation: Unbiased Monte Carlo far-field mean, CVaR90, max, and worst-sector metrics for d7d960548ee7 with 95% confidence intervals, plus consistency checks against the GMC-weighted window, sufficient to assess the verifier's improvement thresholds.
action.decision_reason: The GMC-guided discovery gate and minimum screening requirements are satisfied, GMC budget is exhausted, and Monte Carlo certification is the required next fidelity stage. d7d960548ee7 is the best-ranked GMC-screened candidate, so it is the optimal first allocation of the limited exact-certification budget.

arguments.summary: Unbiased MC certification of GMC-guided candidate d7d960548ee7 gives far-field candidate/baseline=0.271 (72.9% reduction, difference_z=-3.28, 95% CI separated), satisfying the primary source-distant flux objective and the verifier's improvement threshold; GMC tail metrics (CVaR90, max, worst-sector) also improved. Deep-far-field was not separated (z=-0.55).

action.hypothesis: The best GMC-screened, GMC-guided structure already provides a verifier-eligible far-field flux reduction, and with GMC (4/4) and MC (8000/8000) budgets exhausted no further fidelity stage can alter the conclusion.
action.expected_observation: Independent verifier accepts the verified_improvement claim for d7d960548ee7 based on the genvr-cfm-response -> unbiased-mc fidelity chain and the separated far-field 95% interval.
action.decision_reason: Both the GMC screening gate and the MC discovery gate are passed, all GMC and MC resources are spent, and the sole remaining optional tool (projected local-MC audit) is a non-certifying diagnostic that cannot upgrade evidence. Finishing with the single MC-certified improvement is the correct terminal action.

arguments.summary: Unbiased MC certification of GMC-guided candidate d7d960548ee7 gives far-field candidate/baseline=0.271 (72.9% reduction, difference_z=-3.28, 95% CI separated), satisfying the primary source-distant flux objective and the verifier's improvement threshold; GMC tail metrics (CVaR90, max, worst-sector) also improved. Deep-far-field was not separated (z=-0.55).

objective.tail: reduce far-field CVaR90, maximum, and worst angular sector
objective.gmc_role: primary high-throughput structure evaluator and MC weight-window guide
objective.mc_role: unbiased physical certification for selected structures
objective.fom_role: verification efficiency only; never the shielding objective
